categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as an investment holding company with two main subsidiaries: Far Glory Aviation Free Trade Zone Co., Ltd., which manages an aviation free trade zone including warehousing, industrial plant leasing, specialized zone development, real estate leasing, mechanical installation, and air cargo consolidation services; and Far Glory Logistics Co., Ltd., which provides warehousing, industrial plant leasing, packaging, logistics, customs brokerage, and transportation services. The business focuses on integrated logistics and free trade zone operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced automation and information technology in warehousing, including Siemens fully automated storage systems and high-speed fiber optic networks for real-time cargo tracking. It emphasizes integrated logistics services combining warehousing, customs clearance, cargo handling, and transportation, supported by certifications such as TAPA A-level and ISO27001 for information security. The company also develops customized logistics solutions including cold chain storage and cross-border e-commerce logistics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international and domestic logistics companies, air cargo carriers, express delivery firms (e.g., DHL, FedEx, KWE), manufacturers especially in AI, semiconductor, and electronics sectors, and multinational corporations seeking regional distribution centers. The company serves importers, exporters, and freight forwarders primarily within Taiwan's aviation free trade zone, targeting industries requiring efficient air cargo handling and value-added logistics services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, specifically at the Taoyuan Aviation Free Trade Zone near Taoyuan International Airport. The company’s services support domestic logistics needs and international air cargo flows, linking Taiwan with global markets through air and sea transport hubs. It also collaborates with international logistics and airline companies to enhance cross-border trade facilitation.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing warehousing, cargo consolidation, customs clearance, and logistics services. It acts as a logistics hub facilitating the movement and storage of goods between manufacturers, freight forwarders, airlines, and end customers, integrating supply chain functions within the free trade zone environment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the aviation free trade zone’s capacity and service offerings, enhancing automation and digitalization of logistics operations, and developing value-added services such as cold chain logistics and cross-border e-commerce support. The company focuses on attracting multinational corporations and high-value industries, leveraging tax incentives and geographic advantages. Although it does not have a dedicated R&D department, it continuously innovates service models and operational efficiency based on market trends and customer needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through leasing industrial plants, warehouses, and office spaces within the free trade zone, as well as service fees from warehousing, cargo handling, customs brokerage, and logistics operations. The company also earns income from long-term contracts with international express delivery firms and airlines for dedicated logistics facilities and services. Investment income from subsidiaries contributes significantly to consolidated earnings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in Taiwan’s aviation free trade zone logistics market with a 28.2% market share in air cargo consolidation services. Competitors include other domestic logistics providers and international express carriers operating in Taiwan. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive integrated services, advanced automation, strategic location, and strong partnerships with global logistics and airline companies, positioning it as a key logistics hub in the Asia-Pacific region.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$3.46 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a net profit of around NT$717 million. It has shown steady revenue growth (~19% year-over-year) and maintains a solid asset base exceeding NT$26 billion. The company’s equity stands at over NT$10 billion, reflecting stable financial health and ongoing investments in infrastructure expansion. Growth is supported by increasing cargo volumes, expanded leasing operations, and strategic investments in subsidiaries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a unique value proposition by combining a strategically located aviation free trade zone with advanced automated warehousing and integrated logistics services. It provides customers with expedited customs clearance, secure and efficient cargo handling, and tailored value-added services such as cold chain logistics and cross-border e-commerce support. Its comprehensive service ecosystem, tax incentives, and strong international partnerships enable clients to optimize supply chain efficiency and reduce operational costs, distinguishing it from competitors.
